name: ottopus
description: Shows an Ottopus plan as a card in Claude Code and follows it until it is signed, confirmed or expired.

server.title: Ottopus server name
server.description: The name you gave the Ottopus MCP server, as /mcp lists it. Leave empty to accept any server whose plans link to the review origin.

reviewOrigin.title: Review origin
reviewOrigin.description: Where review links must lead. Plans linking anywhere else are ignored. Change only for a self-hosted Ottopus.
